text:
mira.chen: Heads up — customer ACME reported an embeddings shape change after we applied the frozen/pinned variant for inference. Their downstream index started failing validation. They say vectors used to be 1536 and are now 1024.

raj.patel: ack. which model did they pin to and when was the pin applied?

mira.chen: They pinned `redwood-embed-open-1536@v2026-02-01` on 2026-03-01 02:14 UTC via the console (reserved capacity). The pin/lock was applied as part of a compliance freeze.

tom.nguyen: can they paste a raw response sample? need to confirm it's not just a client-side reshape.

mira.chen: pasted from their API curl output (redacted):
```
POST /v1/embeddings
{ "model":"redwood-embed-open-1536@v2026-02-01", "input": "test" }
HTTP/1.1 200 OK
{ "data": [ { "embedding": [0.001, 0.002, ..., 0.345] } ], "model": "redwood-embed-open-1536@v2026-02-01" }
```
They truncated, but their client library throws an assertion expecting length==1536 and sees 1024.

raj.patel: interesting. server returned the same model id string, but embedding length mismatch. two hypotheses: 1) there's a variant aliasing issue where the pinned identifier maps to a lower-dim quantized variant on certain nodes, 2) automatic fallback to a compatible variant (e.g., -sparse/quant) during load balancing.

alyssa.park: deploy-bot shows a canary -> frozen promotion event at 2026-03-01T02:12:07Z for that model id. Also a recent kernel change to the batching path landed 2026-02-28. Could be new batching + prefix-caching causing variant resolution to use a different artifact.

deploy-bot: [promotion] model redwood-embed-open-1536@v2026-02-01 promoted to frozen pool in region us-west-2 by @deployer (run: deploy-20260301-42).

tom.nguyen: ask customer to run a direct /rpc/raw_embed call (no CDN) to confirm server output: 
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <key>" -X POST https://us-west-2.api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/raw \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-embed-open-1536@v2026-02-01","input":"hello"}'
```
If raw returns 1024 then it's server-side. If raw returns 1536 then it's a client transform.

mira.chen: they ran raw and confirmed 1024. they also said only ~15% of requests are 1024, rest are 1536 — intermittent.

raj.patel: intermittent points at routing. check routing policy logs for that customer key — maybe some requests routed to a legacy pool that hosts a down-leveled artifact with trimmed head dims. I pushed a trace-config for their API key to sample 100% of requests for 10m.

alyssa.park: also check batching/batchpad heuristics. If a request hits a GPU worker running a stripped quant variant with `embed_width=1024`, the runtime might still advertise the canonical model id. Need to validate artifact metadata on frozen pool nodes.

tom.nguyen: steps to repro locally (internal):
1) use `inference-local` container with model artifact `redwood-embed-open-1536@v2026-02-01`
2) run varying batch sizes (1, 8, 32) with mix of zero-length and long prompts
3) toggle `batchpad_mode` between `off`, `pad_to_max`, `adaptive`
record returned embedding length and server-side artifact sha.

mira.chen: customer asked for an expedited mitigation — can we temporarily route their requests to a verified canary variant with explicit `@sha:...` artifact id?

raj.patel: yes. ops can create a per-customer routing override to pin to artifact sha (not the frozen alias). That avoids alias-resolution surprises. I'll prepare the override and hold until we confirm artifact parity.

alyssa.park: I'll run a script to list artifact metadata on frozen pool nodes and compare `embed_dim` field across replicas. quick check:
```
for node in $(list-frozen-nodes us-west-2); do 
  curl http://$node:9000/artifact/meta/redwood-embed-open-1536@v2026-02-01
done
```

tom.nguyen: if we confirm mixed artifact dims, file a hotfix: mark mismatched replicas as quarantined and trigger re-roll to correct artifact. Also roll back kernel batching change as last resort.

mira.chen: customer accepted routing override and provided permission for us to do the temporary pin-by-sha. I'll update after override is in place.

raj.patel: created override (route override id: r-90821). Monitoring now.

mira.chen: initial sample post-override: all embeddings returned 1536 for 200 requests. Customer reports immediate reduction in index failures.

tom.nguyen: great. next actions: (1) inventory frozen pool artifacts and patch any that report embed_dim !=1536, (2) audit alias->sha resolution path to ensure pinned aliases cannot map to incompatible variants, (3) add an automated check that validates artifact metadata at promote time.

mira.chen: filing the follow-up incident ticket with the investigation notes for the SRE/infra teams. Thanks all. :heart:
